name: python-official-docs
instructions: The official documentation of Python, kept locally: the language reference, the standard library, the tutorial and the how-to guides, and the API of the Inkscape extensions (inkex) with their guides. Search with search_docs, then read one section with read_doc. Look an API up rather than guess it.
search: Search the official documentation of Python (language reference, standard library, tutorial, how-to guides) and of the Inkscape extensions (the inkex API and the guides for extension authors). Returns 10 section ids at most.
